## Historical audit — H0131

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane0/codex_parallel_12_lane0_I_r1/infer_logs/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/turn_1/trajs.json` (`trajs.json` below). Character ranges refer to the supplied decoded observations.

| Question | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The task label and the student’s search suggest work on recursive multi-agent delegation in a provider-based application. The original task request and its exact acceptance criteria are not visible, so that semantic goal remains an inference. [H0131, `trajs.json`, main_agent:event:4, chars 0–763) |
| Exploration and input | The student invoked the `claude-api` skill; its delivered instructions said to stop and ask on explicit provider-neutral constraints or non-Anthropic provider markers. The student then inspected the repository, Git status and branches, and searched delegation and provider symbols. Results included an OpenAI provider test and provider interfaces. This was autonomous exploration, not delegation to another agent. [events 1–5, chars 0–566, 0–377, 0–131023, 0–763, 0–6918 respectively] |
| Decision and changes | The student claimed an explicit provider-neutral constraint and asked whether to proceed provider-neutrally or switch the relevant flow to Claude. It reported no changes or commit. The visible search supports the presence of OpenAI-related code, but does not itself show the claimed explicit constraint. No edit or implementation operation appears in the sequence. [event:5, chars 0–6918; event:6, chars 0–839] |
| Validation and outcome | No student test run is visible. Supplied inventory metadata reports a zero-byte `patch.diff`, 0/7 fail-to-pass tests and 31/31 pass-to-pass tests: **empty patch, formally not solved**, despite a normal `end_turn`. These aggregate results do not establish an algorithmic failure or a partially correct implementation. [H0131 inventory metadata; `trajs.json`, top_level_metadata, chars 0–4847) |
| Teacher | Hint and review files are listed as available, but their contents and delivery are not shown. The trace reports zero teacher checks; no teacher input or adoption is established. The invoked skill was delivered tool content, not evidence of a teacher hint. [H0131 inventory metadata; `trajs.json`, top_level_metadata, chars 0–4847; events 1–3] |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, distinguish an instruction-triggered pause from technical interruption or an attempted algorithm that failed, and distinguish available advice from received advice. Task-specifically, the skill’s provider-marker rule visibly preceded the pause, but whether it was applicable to the unseen request, whether clarification would have resolved the issue, and what implementation was required remain unresolved. No scene or image evidence is involved.
